# lettermint_route (Data Source)

Reads a Lettermint route, for example to get inbound_mx_hostname before creating the MX record for lettermint_route_inbound.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lettermint_route" "inbound" {
  id = var.route_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Route id.

### Read-Only

- `attachment_delivery` (String) inline or url.
- `inbound_address` (String) The route's own inbound address.
- `inbound_domain` (String) Custom receiving domain, or null.
- `inbound_domain_verified_at` (String) When the inbound domain was verified, or null.
- `inbound_mx_hostname` (String) Host an inbound domain's MX record must point to.
- `name` (String) Route name.
- `project_id` (String) Project the route belongs to.
- `route_type` (String) transactional, broadcast or inbound.
- `slug` (String) Route slug.
- `spam_threshold` (Number) Inbound spam threshold.
